title: hidroquimica: hydrochemistry toolkit in TypeScript (Piper, Stiff, Schoeller, ion balance)
description: Open-source TypeScript library for hydrochemistry: mg/L ↔ meq/L ↔ mmol/L conversions, ion balance with selectable acceptance criteria, Piper diagram coordinates, Stiff and Schoeller diagrams, dominant-ion facies and parsing of Brazilian-formatted lab results. Used by the free tools at https://phreatica.com/ferramentas/.
